keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, no Cliopatria row (Cliopatria's East Turkestan Republic is the 1945-1949 state): FE says it 'claimed authority over territory stretching from Aksu along the northern rim of the Tarim Basin to Khotan in the south' and gives no area. The three radii (about 150,000 km2 together) are a floor; Yarkand and Maralbashi are not named as held.

region.text: territory 'stretching from Aksu along the northern rim of the Tarim Basin to Khotan in the south' (FE), with Kashgar the capital

ledger.note: 1933: the Turkic Islamic Republic of Eastern Turkestan is proclaimed at Kashgar. 'On 12 November 1933, Sabit Damolla declared the establishment of the East Turkestan Republic', with Khoja Niyaz as president; infobox 'Established: 12 November 1933'. The Khotan Emirate had declared independence on 16 March 1933 under its own emirs.

region.text: territory 'stretching from Aksu along the northern rim of the Tarim Basin to Khotan in the south' (FE), with Kashgar the capital

ledger.note: 1934: Hui forces end the republic. They 'linked up with Ma Zhancang's forces in Kashgar'; the government was forced 'to flee on 6 February 1934' to Yengi Hissar and 'Ma Zhongying effectively destroyed TIRET'. The infobox says 'Disestablished: 16 April 1934'.

wars.name: Ma Zhongying's campaign against the East Turkestan Republic
wars.outcome: Ma Zhancang's and Ma Zhongying's Hui troops took Kashgar in February 1934 and destroyed the republic.
wars.note: The page gives no start for the Hui advance.

certainty.note: A republic of oases with no frontier described on the page.

sources.title: First East Turkestan Republic
sources.note: Proclaimed 12 November 1933 at Kashgar; Khoja Niyaz president, Sabit Damolla prime minister; Aksu to Khotan; the Khotan Emirate of 16 March 1933; government fled 6 February 1934; infobox disestablished 16 April 1934.

notes: Written for batch ia-03-x from one page (FE; budget 1-2). The page gives no area and names no territory beyond Aksu, Kashgar and Khotan; Yarkand is only a route and Maral Bashi a front-line town. The Khotan Emirate (Muhammad Amin Bughra, declared independence 16 March 1933, 'Emir of the Khotan Emirate (1933-1934)') is a separate short-lived state and has no dossier. The end is the flight of 6 February 1934; the infobox's 16 April 1934 is noted. The republic-of-china dossier (ea-08) should carry the matching loss and gain; Cliopatria's East Turkestan Republic (1945-49) is a different state (east-turkestan-republic, ia-03-f).
